archive.contents: Exact source bundle and Linux example binary; full confirmation raw tasks, task receipts, scheduled aggregate, summaries, build and accounting records, logs, local audit and reaggregation receipt; smoke and local tiny/preflight receipts. Redundant locally reaggregated raw confirmation copy excluded.

interpretation: Independent confirmation for q0 on the prospectively eligible diffuse fixed-offset match designs. Independent matches and a correct named model for aggregate match variance remain assumptions; dependence within a match is unrestricted through its scalar aggregate variance. Estimated-offset, weak/null, and spectral diagnostics do not acquire a calibration claim. This is not joint-control inference, unrestricted between-match covariance, or public/native-artifact qualification.
